source_name: LA County Assessor Public Portal
verification_note: URL appeared literally in WebSearch result listing (query: 'portal.assessor.lacounty.gov property search').
terms_notes: Interactive lookup for ~2.7M properties (AIN/address/map search); no bulk export from portal — use open-data roll datasets instead. Check ToS before scraping.
difficulty_reason: Per-parcel interactive app; bulk route exists elsewhere.
notes: Prop 13 regime: assessed value = acquisition base-year value +max 2%/yr; reassessment only on sale/new construction; NO market reassessment cycle. Assessed value is not a market proxy; model post-sale reassessment to purchase price.
